subtitle: Visa-sponsored jobs in Europe
promotional_text: Search jobs and volunteer placements with evidence of visa sponsorship. Build a CV and cover letter in English, French or Arabic, then export and share them.
description:
EuroJobs Pro is a job board built around one question: will this employer actually support a work visa?

Every listing is classified into one of two evidence tiers:

• Tier 1 — the employer matches an official government sponsor register for that country.
• Tier 2 — the posting itself explicitly mentions visa sponsorship or relocation support.

Listings with no evidence, or with phrases such as “no sponsorship”, do not appear in sponsored results.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Search jobs and volunteer placements separately, so paid roles and unpaid programmes are never mixed.
• Filter by country, city, category, remote work, salary and visa tier.
• Save listings and return to them later.
• Create a profile once, then generate a CV, a cover letter or a volunteer motivation letter in English, French or Arabic.
• Export documents as PDF or DOCX and share them with the iOS share sheet.
• Ask the career assistant for help with search, applications and relocation.
• Use the whole app in English, French or Arabic, with full right-to-left layout for Arabic and light, dark or system themes.
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID so saved jobs and your CV stay private on a shared phone.

HONEST BY DESIGN

• Listings come from official APIs and public employer career pages. We do not scrape LinkedIn, Indeed or Glassdoor.
• AI-generated documents use only the experience, education and skills you enter. Each draft is checked against your profile and regenerated once if anything cannot be verified.
• Contact details, ID numbers and your exact date of birth are never sent to the AI model.
• No ads, no tracking, and no sale of personal data.

IMPORTANT

A sponsorship badge is evidence, not a guarantee. A register match shows that the employer holds a sponsor licence; it does not prove that a specific vacancy is eligible. Always confirm visa support with the employer and the relevant immigration authority. Nothing in the app is legal or immigration advice.

Volunteer placements are separated from paid jobs, and fee-charging programmes are hidden by default.

EuroJobs Pro is free to browse. An account is only required to save jobs, create documents and use the assistant.
